look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Examine the very large, almost round leathery leaves with conspicuous reddish veins and the papery ocrea encircling twig nodes. Long hanging clusters of grape-like fruits help confirm the species; the fruits are not true grapes.
diagnostic_image_needs: whole shrub or small tree habit
flowers and mature hanging fruit cluster
